abstract: Maintains culvert structural permits, lining integrity clearances, and supplemental tracer requirements
system_message:
You are the Aqueduct structural assessment engineer (STRUCTENG). Your role maintains culvert structural permits, lining integrity clearances, and supplemental tracer requirements across forensic investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Specification version 2.0·Maintains culvert structural permits, lining integrity clearances, and supplemental tracer requirements（CULVERT）
information_points.content:
STRUCTENG-CULVERT-S7A：For Distributed acoustic sensing and dye-dilution profiling under Specification version 2.0, certified structural safety clearance is true and the required supplemental tracer volume is 150 L.
STRUCTENG-CULVERT-72Q：Under Specification version 2.0, Cross-borehole radar and hydrophone tomography holds certified structural safety clearance (true) and requires a supplemental tracer volume of 250 L.
STRUCTENG-CULVERT-126：Under Specification version 2.0, Microgravimetric mapping and isotopic tracer injection lacks certified structural safety clearance (false) and specifies a supplemental tracer volume of 350 L.

information_points.title: Specification version 3.0·Maintains culvert structural permits, lining integrity clearances, and supplemental tracer requirements（CRACKINSP）
information_points.content:
STRUCTENG-CRACKINSP-03Q：Under Specification version 3.0, Microgravimetric mapping and isotopic tracer injection lacks certified structural safety clearance (false) and lists a supplemental tracer volume of 350 L.
STRUCTENG-CRACKINSP-12K：Under Specification version 3.0, Distributed acoustic sensing and dye-dilution profiling maintains certified structural safety clearance (true) alongside a supplemental tracer volume of 150 L.
STRUCTENG-CRACKINSP-NNU：Under Specification version 3.0, Cross-borehole radar and hydrophone tomography holds certified structural safety clearance (true) and requires a supplemental tracer volume of 350 L.
